passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Great Barrier Reef lies off the coast of Queensland, Australia.
• It is the world's largest coral reef system.
• It is made up of more than 2,900 individual reefs.
• Thousands of species of fish and other animals live there.
stem: The student wants to emphasize the size of the Great Barrier Reef. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Made up of more than 2,900 reefs, the Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest coral reef system.
The Great Barrier Reef, home to thousands of species, lies off the coast of Queensland, Australia.
Thousands of species of fish and other animals make their homes in the Great Barrier Reef.
The Great Barrier Reef is found off the northeastern coast of the Australian state of Queensland.
steps: Two notes are about size: 2,900+ reefs and "world's largest."
The others focus on location or wildlife.
key: Choose the sentence built from the notes that match the goal's key word.
